an10.72:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ
an10.72:1.2: āyasmatā ca cālena āyasmatā ca upacālena āyasmatā ca kakkaṭena āyasmatā ca kaṭimbena āyasmatā ca kaṭena āyasmatā ca kaṭissaṅgena
an10.72:1.3: aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.
an10.72:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi carapurāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.72:2.3: “ime kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi carapurāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.72:2.4: saddakaṇṭakā kho pana jhānā vuttā bhagavatā,
an10.72:2.6: tattha mayaṃ appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsuṃ vihareyyāmā”ti.
an10.72:2.7: atha kho te āyasmanto yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
an10.72:2.8: tattha te āyasmanto appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsuṃ viharanti.
an10.72:3.2: “kahannukho bhikkhave cālo? kahaṃ upacālo? kahaṃ kakkaṭo? kahaṃ kaṭimbo? kahaṃ kaṭo? kahaṃ kaṭisaṅgo?
an10.72:3.3: kahannu kho te bhikkhave therā sāvakā gatāti?
an10.72:4.2: “ime kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā. licchavī bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi carapurāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhantī bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, saddakaṇṭakā kho pana jhānā vuttā bhagavatā, yannūna mayaṃ yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkameyyāma, tattha mayaṃ appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsuṃ vihareyyāmā”ti.
an10.72:4.3: atha kho te bhante āyasmanto yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
an10.72:4.4: tattha te āyasmanto appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsuṃ viharantīti.
an10.72:5.1: sādhu sādhu bhikkhave yathā te mahāsāvakā sammā byākaramānā byākareyyuṃ. saddakaṇṭakā hi bhikkhave jhānā vuttā mayā.
an10.72:6.3: pavivekārāmassa saṅghanikārāmatā kaṇṭako, asubhanimittānuyogamanuyuttassa subhanimittānuyogo kaṇṭako, indriyesu guttadvārassa visūkadassanaṃ kaṇṭako, brahmacārissa mātugāmopavicāro kaṇṭako, paṭhamassa jhānassa saddo kaṇṭako, dutiyassa jhānassa vitakkavicārā kaṇṭako tatiyassa jhānassa pīti kaṇṭako, catutthassa jhānassa assāsapassāsā kaṇṭako, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā saññā ca vedanā ca kaṇṭako, rāgo kaṇṭako, deso kaṇṭako, moho kaṇṭako,
